what_this_is: The Nick Crown macro layer: positioning, breadth and regime read BEFORE any individual stock. It answers what kind of market this is, and therefore which family of trades is allowed today. It is deliberately separate from AQE's stock scanner and sector work.
status_means: it ran, but something was missing or on a substitute source — see limits

read_me_first.headline: A market with no clear breadth lead, and quiet.
why: Breadth is going sideways — neither the big names nor the average stock is leading.
Single stocks are moving about as much as the index. The index itself is quiet, with VIX at 14.3, lower than 95% of the past two years.
Trend-following funds are mixed across the 18 markets we track, and none is at an extreme — the positioning is not crowded.
Big speculators are unusually long the dollar, gold, copper and 6 others; unusually short natural gas and the long bond (CFTC data to 2026-08-25).

1 warning sign lit: price is climbing while momentum falls. A further 12 showed up on individual markets. No single one of these is a reason to sell. They matter when several point the same way as the breadth reading.
read_me_first.so_what: Own the average stock, not just the leaders — and collect premium against it. That is the closest fit rather than a clean one — 2 of its conditions are not met. Size at 1.00x your normal risk.
what_would_change_it: If the dollar trades above 99.65 (0.6% away), trend funds start buying.
If the 2-year trades above 103.58 (0.9% away), trend funds start buying.
Watch for single stocks becoming more volatile while the index stays calm. That gap is the earliest warning we get.
caveats: No dealer-positioning read today, so nothing above accounts for option hedging flows.

the_call.size_multiplier_means: Multiply the PM's OWN normal risk per trade by this. AQE does not size and does not know the book.

playbook.context: Heartbeat rising, range not extreme, gamma positive, dispersion normal.
playbook.equity: Long RSP or equal-weight financials / healthcare basket
playbook.pair: Long equal-weight sector / short the matching mega-cap
playbook.options: Bull call verticals, or long stock + short OTM calls (carry)

scenario.reading: DISPERSION_REGIME leads but INFLATION_SHOCK is within 12%. Two stories fit the same tape; treat the overlap as the honest read, not the winner.
scenario.story: A stock-picker's tape. Implied correlation collapses and single-stock vol pulls away from a calm index — the index tells you almost nothing about what the average name is doing.

trend_funds.extreme_means: how crowded the trade is. High is fragile, not confident.

large_speculators.note: CFTC data covering Tuesday, published Friday, so always at least three days old. It cannot time anything.

how_to_read.read_me_first: The whole reading in plain English. If you only read one block, read this one. Everything else is the evidence.
how_to_read.the_call: The allowed FAMILY of trade expressions and a multiplier on the PM's own risk budget. Never a ticker, never a position, never an order. The individual setup is the PM's choice.
how_to_read.how_current: Every source with its own date. The reading is only as current as its oldest leg, whatever the generated time says.
how_to_read.scenario: Which cross-asset story best fits today. The score is the SHARE OF CONDITIONS MET, not a probability — nothing here was fitted or backtested and no base rate was measured.
how_to_read.readings: The four stages behind the call: breadth, positioning, volatility and divergence.
how_to_read.what_changed: Only the moves since the last run that would change what a PM does. An empty list means today continues yesterday.
how_to_read.what_is_coming: Scheduled moments when the reading above can change. Each carries what it tests, not a forecast.
how_to_read.key_levels: EVERY line in the sand this layer knows about, in one list sorted nearest first. Most are NOT prices: a breadth ratio, a volatility gap and a correlation percentile all have levels that change the regime when they break. Rows with kind='trend followers' are where systematic funds turn from buyer to seller, and any row with quotable_as_contract false carries a tracking fund's price rather than the contract's.
how_to_read.limits: What was missing or degraded in this run. Read before trusting anything above.
